title: Every agent run on the work counts toward its cost
situation: Raised by the lead realizing intent-based delegation, 2026-10-15. Agent runs launched other than by a dispatch the harness records were only warned about, so their cost was missing from the ledger.
decision: Every agent run that works on a story or task counts toward its cost, by role, tokens and elapsed time, however it was launched. How the harness captures such runs is the lead's choice.
consequences: Capturing runs launched outside a recorded dispatch is a follow-up task.
